svg.title: Attention performance across eleven GPU targets
svg.desc: Default SDPA time divided by selected CuTe time. Each cell uses a same-process comparison from its retained study. F is training forward, I is NoGrad forward, F+B includes forward and all gradients. Gray cells have no retained comparison. Values are graph replay, not eager or model speedups.
svg.text: Attention performance · default SDPA time / CuTe time
Above 1×: CuTe faster (teal) · below 1×: SDPA faster (brown) · gray: no retained comparison
F = training forward · I = NoGrad forward · F+B = forward + all gradients · BF = BF16 · FP = FP16 · D/C = dense/causal
Warmed CUDA-event graph replay, milliseconds per call; compilation excluded. Hover cells for timings and study/run provenance.
4 source cohort(s) · exact hardware/stack per study in JSON
